bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2024-02-15.26.1) introduced by Forde MP [Bert Van Manen](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/forde/bert_van_manen) (Liberal), which means it failed. The amendment would have changed the name of the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 1, page 1 (lines 5 and 6), omit "Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts) Act 2024", substitute "Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts but Not Actually Dealing with the Cost of Living) Act 2024".*
